cards.observation_text: The lineage report excludes the toothless, scale-armored branch.
cards.inference_text: The candidate from that branch is no longer a match.
cards.bonus_fact_text: Its wider lineage includes hyraxes, sea cows, tenrecs, and golden moles.
hints: The family tree avoids the branch of scale-armored mammals.

hints.text: This family tree does not run through the cattle and antelope group.
Its genes sit with an ancient African branch of mammals, far from cats, bats, and hoofed grazers.

cards.observation_text: The body record does not show the combination of a striped coat and feline paws.
cards.inference_text: Cross off the candidate with that combination; the other body plans still fit.
cards.bonus_fact_text: Its trunk combines breathing, smelling, touching, grasping, and sound production.
hints: The silhouette is broad and upright, not low and feline.

hints.text: No sign of the tiny sand-burrowing body plan.
Heavy ground impressions repeat beside selective bark removal; storm breakage cannot explain both.

cards.observation_text: The resting behavior record excludes communal roosting in treetops.
cards.inference_text: The canopy-colony candidate can be removed from consideration.
cards.bonus_fact_text: Related females and young form social herds led by experienced adults.
hints: The social group gathers on the ground.

hints.text: It does not roll into an armored ball when threatened.
Repeated group travel reopens one corridor; the damage is concentrated rather than region-wide.

cards.observation_text: The diet record excludes specialization in sparse Saharan grasses and shrubs.
cards.inference_text: The candidate adapted to that desert forage is a poor fit.
cards.bonus_fact_text: A varied plant diet can include grasses, bark, roots, leaves, and cultivated crops.
hints: This feeder needs a great volume of vegetation.

hints.text: Diet notes rule out an ant-and-termite specialist.
Plant feeding leaves external browse marks, not the internal galleries of wood-boring insects.

cards.observation_text: The native range extends beyond the coastal dunes of Namaqualand.
cards.inference_text: A species confined to that dune belt cannot explain this range.
cards.bonus_fact_text: Remaining populations occur in fragmented habitats across South and Southeast Asia.
hints: The map footprint spans far more than one coastal dune belt.

hints.text: Climate reading: warm tropical conditions all year.
